BiblicalUsage: Thou is the Aramaic word for you, the address Daniel uses to the king: thou, O king, sawest a great image, and thou art the head of gold. It is the plain second person, the word a prophet uses to a king.
TheologicalSignificance: A pronoun in Aramaic holds no doctrine; its interest is the scene, a captive prophet telling a king what he dreamed.
